title: Pure Dracotail
summary: Pure Dracotail Dragon and Spellcaster Fusion build with Filia Regis, Guardian Chimera, and generic staples. Every Main Deck Dracotail monster Sets a Dracotail Spell or Trap directly from the Deck whenever it is sent to the GY as material for a Fusion Summon.

summary.title: Starters & Fusion Spells
points: Dracotail Lukias searches any Dracotail monster on Normal or Special Summon, and Dracotail Phryxul revives a Dracotail monster from the GY on Normal or Special Summon.
Ketu Dracotail adds any Dracotail monster from the Deck to your hand, and if your opponent controls a monster you can immediately Fusion Summon a Dragon or Spellcaster Fusion Monster.
Rahu Dracotail Fusion Summons a Dracotail Fusion Monster using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field as Fusion Material, triggering your Deck material's GY Set effect immediately.
Dracotail Faimena discards itself from the hand as a Quick Effect during either player's Main Phase to Fusion Summon a Dragon or Spellcaster Fusion Monster using monsters from your hand or field.

summary.title: Opening: Rahu Dracotail or Lukias + Faimena
steps: Normal Summon Dracotail Lukias to search Dracotail Faimena or Dracotail Pan, or activate Rahu Dracotail to Fusion Summon Dracotail Arthalion or Dracotail Gulamel using materials from your hand, Deck, or field.

Every Dracotail monster sent to the GY as Fusion Material triggers in the GY to Set a Dracotail Spell/Trap (Rahu, Ketu, Flame, Horn, or Sting) directly from the Deck, while Pan also destroys a monster, Urgula destroys a Spell/Trap, and Mululu negates a face-up monster.
Keep Dracotail Faimena in hand (or recover her with Urgula's GY effect) to Quick-Fusion into Guardian Chimera, Filia Regis, or another Dracotail Fusion during the opponent's Main Phase.

summary.title: Fusion Bosses & Self-Revival
summary.text: Dracotail Arthalion (Level 8 Dragon Fusion) returns monsters on the field and/or in the GYs to the hand up to the number of monsters in the hand used as its Fusion Material, while Dracotail Gulamel (Level 9 Spellcaster Fusion) destroys 1 card the opponent controls as a Quick Effect whenever you activate a Dracotail card or effect. Both Arthalion and Gulamel revive themselves from the GY whenever 2 or more monsters are sent to the GY at the same time, such as during a Fusion Summon.

summary.title: Disruption Traps & Extra Deck Payoff
points: Dracotail Flame negates the effects of 1 face-up Spell on the field, Dracotail Horn returns 1 Attack Position monster to the hand or Extra Deck, and Dracotail Sting banishes 1 monster and/or 1 Spell/Trap from the opponent's GY; each Trap then shuffles 1 other Dracotail card from your GY or banishment into the Deck to draw 1 card.
Dracotail Shaulas provides additional banish disruption and Spell/Trap setting, while Filia Regis banishes a card from the opponent's field or GY as a Quick Effect.
Guardian Chimera, summoned on the opponent's turn via Dracotail Faimena, draws cards and destroys cards on the field while triggering every Dracotail material sent to the GY.

allow.Filia Regis: Dragon Fusion boss accessible via Rahu Dracotail or Ketu Dracotail that banishes cards from the field or GY as a Quick Effect.
allow.Guardian Chimera: Level 9 Fusion boss that can be summoned on the opponent's turn via Dracotail Faimena to draw cards and pop opposing threats while triggering Dracotail GY Set effects.
